title: Auxiliary: essere or avere?
description: Passato prossimo sentences where you must decide between essere (motion, change of state) and avere (most other verbs).

title: Passato prossimo or imperfetto?
description: Past-tense sentences where you must tell background (imperfetto) from completed events (passato prossimo).

title: Definite article forms
description: Nouns that need il, lo, l', la, i, gli or le: decide from gender, number and first sound.

title: Essere or avere?
description: Present-tense sentences where you choose between 'to be' and 'to have' (including hunger, age, heat and cold).

title: Tu or Lei?
description: Situations where you choose informal (tu) or formal (Lei) address and the matching verb form.
